== Summary ==
PC Errata 2016 disc card image of [[Blaster (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]: PC Errata 2016 disc card (Players Committee card image with a bronze disc mark, starwarsccg.org card lists).

Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/blaster.gif blaster.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160810102100/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/blaster.gif Internet Archive] (10 August 2016, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 21 July 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260721021825/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/blaster.gif Internet Archive].

Uploaded unchanged (SHA-1 <code>990f13a35aee07badd27304b4144001ab5d42012</code>).
